text.description_html:
First Impressions 3220 23" Square Stainless Steel Pull

Modern designed door pulls made of 5/8" square solid stainless steel by First Impressions, a leader manufacture in door pulls. They requiring little maintenance, designed to enhance any setting where a modern, sharp, crisp look is desired. Satin Stainless Steel finish.

Specifications for First Impressions 3220/23-US32D Stainless Steel Pulls

  • Total Length: 23"
  • Diameter: 5/8" Square
  • Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Note: These stainless steel door pulls are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 4 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door).

*Sold individually.
